description: Java source file defining the VaultProvider class, which extends Android's DocumentsProvider to offer encrypted document storage with metadata and content encryption, supporting document management operations such as create, query, rename, delete, and open.

classes.name: VaultProvider
classes.description: An Android DocumentsProvider implementation that encrypts metadata and content of files stored in a secure vault, managing documents and directories with encryption keys stored securely.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the provider, loads encryption keys, and sets up the root document.

methods.name: queryRoots
methods.description: Returns root document representing the vault.

methods.name: queryDocument
methods.description: Returns metadata for a specified document.

methods.name: queryChildDocuments
methods.description: Returns a list of child documents for a directory.

methods.name: openDocument
methods.description: Opens a document for reading or writing, returning a ParcelFileDescriptor.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document with specified MIME type and display name.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document and its references.

methods.name: startRead
methods.description: Handles threaded reading of a document, returns a reliable pipe.

methods.name: startWrite
methods.description: Handles threaded writing to a document, returns a reliable pipe.
